notes.title: Public Playtest starts 3rd of October!
notes.content:
[b]Our Delverium public playtest is scheduled for 12am Friday 3rd October through to 12am Tuesday 7th October (Pacific Time).[/b]

In addition to new content, bug fixes and other improvements, the playtest will support four player online co-op! Please join the playtest and share your valuable feedback.

[b]Playtest Goals:[/b][list][*]Check the performance and stability of online co-op multiplayer[/*][*]Gather feedback on the latest content and improvements[/*][*]Allow playtesters to help influence the long term direction of Delverium[/*][/list]
[b]What is in the Playtest Build:[/b][list][*]Online multiplayer or local split-screen co-op with friends[/*][*]Core game loops and progression[/*][*]Building, farming, mining, crafting and combat mechanics[/*][*]A few hours of game content[/*][*]Steam Deck support[/*][/list]
[b]Please Note:[/b][list][*]Save games might not be compatible with future playtest builds[/*][*]Playtest access will be revoked at the end of the playtest period[/*][*]Steam page playtest requests will be approved from 3rd October onwards, but email subscribers will receive exclusive early playtest access from 30th September[/*][/list]
Keep in mind this is an early build so expect some bugs and missing content /features. We need your help and feedback on our latest changes, so please get involved and let us know your thoughts!

Sign up to our email newsletter to receive early playtest access on 30th September:

[b][url="https://subscribepage.io/JKHyRx"]Sagestone Games Email Signup[/url][/b]

And feel free to join our Discord to chat with us and other players!

[b][url=https://discord.com/invite/YR3f74fQFw]JOIN OUR DISCORD[/url][/b]

As always, thank you so much for your support and being part of Delverium’s journey!

- Skoddle

notes.title: Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
The Delverium Demo is now LIVE! Grab your tools and delve into a world full of exploration and adventure. Play either solo or local co-op with up to 4 friends.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3426800/Delverium_Demo/

This Demo version allows players to experience the starting biomes, dungeons and early-game content of Delverium. Players should expect up to an hour or two of exploration and gameplay.  The full game will contain additional biomes, boss fights, gear, fishing, quests, online multiplayer and more! 

Join our Official Delverium Discord and hang out with the developers, chat with other players or share your thoughts and feedback.

[b][url=https://discord.com/invite/YR3f74fQFw]JOIN OUR DISCORD[/url][/b]

If you enjoy the Demo and haven't done so already, please support us by wishlisting Delverium!

- Skoddle

notes.title: Delverium Demo Launches February 7
notes.content:
The Demo offers a glimpse of Delverium’s core features with up to a few hours of solo or local co-op fun! Experience the early-game content with a mixture of exploration, farming, building and combat mechanics for up to 4 local players.

The full game (planned for release later in 2025) will expand with additional biomes, boss fights, gear, fishing, quests, online multiplayer and more. We invite you to join our journey, share feedback, and connect with us on Discord to help shape Delverium into something truly special.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/YR3f74fQFw]Join Our Discord![/url]

Delverium is an open world survival craft adventure where you explore a vast procedurally generated world with 1-4 players. Gather resources, build shelters, tend your farm, recruit NPC's, craft items or take on high risk dungeon crawling as you delve into the unknown. Be warned: Only the most courageous hero can uncover the secrets to Delverium.

- Skoddle

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3426800/Delverium_Demo/

notes.title: Playtest starting on 13th December!
notes.content:
A new Delverium playtest is scheduled for 12am Friday 13th December through to 12am Monday 23rd December 2024 (Pacific Time)!

The new playtest contains a mix of previous feedback changes, additional content, bug fixes and various other improvements. We need and value everyone's feedback, so please join us again and let us know your thoughts!

[b]Playtest Goals:[/b]
[list]
[*] Gather feedback on the core controls, mechanics and early-game content
[*] Allow playtesters to help influence the long term direction of Delverium
[/list]
[b]What is in the Playtest Build:[/b]
[list]
[*] Core early-game loops and progression
[*] A few hours of early-game content
[*] Building, farming, mining, crafting and combat mechanics
[*] Local split-screen co-op (online multiplayer is still in development)
[*] Steam Deck support
[/list]
[b]Please Note:[/b]
[list]
[*] Playtest codes will be emailed out to our email subscribers when the playtest starts
[*] Playtest codes will be revoked after the playtest ends
[*] Save games will not be compatible with future playtest builds
[/list]
Please keep in mind this is still an early build so expect a few bugs and some missing content /features. Getting Delverium right is super important to us, so we want to involve our community early to help us make Delverium something truly special!

To be part of our playtest, please sign up to receive a free playtest code and our newsletter at:

[b]NOTE: Registrations for this playtest have now closed, but you can still sign up for future playtests and our newsletter below![/b]

[url=https://subscribepage.io/JKHyRx]Sagestone Games Email Signup[/url]

As always, thank you so much for your support and being part of Delverium’s journey!

- Skoddle

notes.title: Roadmap for Q4 2024
notes.content:
Thank you so much to everyone who took part in our first Steam Playtest! It has been very rewarding to see so many players enjoying our early playtest build and letting us know their thoughts and criticisms. We have incorporated many of the highest priority feedback items and requests into our roadmap for the next few months. Thank you again for all of the valuable feedback we received!

[u][b]Roadmap:[/b][/u]

[b]Control Improvements (In progress):[/b]
[list]
[*] Add the ability to attack, move, interact and build while the inventory menu is open
[*] Building/Placement previews
[*] Implement missing QoL inventory management features
[/list]
[b]Combat Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improve weapon attack hits and knockbacks
[*] Improve enemy lunges and attack telegraphs
[*] Add player hit/damage feedback
[*] Rebalance weapon and enemy damage
[/list]
[b]NPCs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Don’t stop on doorways/gates
[*] Move out of the way of player building/placement
[*] Enter buildings at night
[*] Attack nearby enemies
[*] More dialog, shop and quest options
[/list]
[b]Animals and Farming:[/b]
[list]
[*] Sheep!
[*] Prevent immature crops from being destroyed by player weapons
[*] Watered soil visuals
[/list]
[b]Other:[/b]
[list]
[*] Lore
[*] Equipable Items
[*] Additional Boss
[/list]
For now it is full steam ahead on our roadmap and working towards our next Playtest build. While we don’t have a firm date for our next Playtest just yet, rest assured we will announce it to our email subscribers, Steam page and socials as soon as we can.

Thank you so much for being part of our journey!

- Skoddle

notes.title: Early Delverium Playtest starting on the 12th of August!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce our very first Steam Playtest will run from Midnight 12th August to Midnight 18th August 2024 (Pacific Time)! This is a very early build to evaluate the performance and core mechanics of Delverium, so please take a moment to read the following information before deciding if you want to take part.

[b]Playtest Goals:[/b]

[list]
[*] Confirm Delverium runs smoothly on a range of different PC’s
[*] Gather feedback on the core controls, mechanics and early-game content
[*] Allow playtesters to help influence the long term direction of Delverium
[/list]

[b]What is in the Playtest Build:[/b]

[list]
[*] Core early-game loops and progression
[*] A few hours of early-game content
[*] Building, farming, mining, crafting and combat mechanics
[*] Woodlands, forests, swamps and dungeon biomes
[*] Early-game enemies, resources and items
[*] Bugs. Probably lots of bugs
[/list]

[b]What is missing from the Playtest Build:[/b]

[list]
[*] Significantly more content and features
[*] Online multiplayer, fishing and cosmetics
[*] Deeper NPC behaviour and interactions
[*] Tutorials, quests and high-level guidance
[*] Game lore
[*] Localisation
[*] Additional polish, bug fixes and improvements
[/list]

[b]Please Note:[/b]

[list]
[*] Playtest codes will be revoked after the playtest ends
[*] Save games will not be compatible with future playtest builds
[*] This is an early build, please do not share any content online
[/list]
 
In a nutshell, this is a very early playtest build so please don’t expect a polished final product or depth of content at this stage. We are certainly a little anxious about sharing it, but getting the fundamentals right is important to us, and including our community as early as possible will help make Delverium great.

If we haven’t scared you off and you still want to be part of our playtests, please sign up to receive free playtest codes and our newsletter at:

[b]NOTE: Registrations for the current playtest have now closed, but you can still sign up for future playtests and our newsletter below![/b]

[url=https://subscribepage.io/JKHyRx]Sagestone Games Email Signup[/url]

We will email out free playtest codes to our email subscribers when the playtest starts.

Thank you so much for your support and being part of our journey!

- Skoddle

notes.title: Delverium on show at the Queensland Games Festival, June 22
notes.content:
We are very excited to be demoing Delverium as part of the Queensland Games Festival at the Brisbane Powerhouse on June 22nd! Entry is free, so please drop by if you are local, say hi and get an early look at Delverium.

It isn’t just about Delverium though, so make sure you take a look at all the other great Queensland made games, chat with developers and check out the free hands-on workshops.

[url=https://www.queenslandgamesfestival.com/]Queensland Games Festival[/url]

For those unable to attend, stay tuned! We hope to showcase Delverium at more events and are working hard to prepare a playtest build to share through our Discord server in the near future.

- Skoddle, Sagestone Games
